title: Coefficient of Variation based Decision Tree (CvDT)
authors: Hima Bindu K.; Swarupa Rani K.; Raghavendra Rao C.
venue: Int. J. Innovative Technology & Creative Engineering 1(6):1-6
methodological_overlap: keyword-adjacent: Cv = sigma/mu used as IMPURITY measure (CvGain), not a dispersion penalty on gain
difference_from_SPDT: no bootstrap; CV is the impurity itself; largest CvGain wins
difference_from_normalized_SPDT: same as SPDT column: CV measures node purity, never penalizes variability of gain
novelty_risk: LOW for formulas (distinct mechanism); must be cited as adjacent prior art

title: Coefficient of Variation Based Decision Tree for Fuzzy Classification
authors: Hima Bindu K.; Raghavendra Rao C.
methodological_overlap: same CvGain impurity per decision category for fuzzy classification

title: CV-based DT Classifier for Face Recognition with Invariant Moments
methodological_overlap: application of CvDT; no formula overlap

title: A New Splitting Criterion for Better Interpretable Trees
authors: Hwang S.; Yeo H.G.; Hong J.-S.
methodological_overlap: modified split criterion (coverage-based penalty) from same Hong group
difference_from_SPDT: penalty targets rule coverage/interpretability, not gain variability

title: Assessing Decision Tree Stability: A Comprehensive Method (ANLS)
authors: Lee J.; Sim M.K.; Hong J.-S.
methodological_overlap: CONCEPTUAL: per-node bootstrap stabilization of split selection; no variance of gain ever computed; modal predictor via binomial Z test
difference_from_SPDT: SPDT subtracts lambda*Var_b(Gain) from score; ANLS votes the modal predictor with median cutoff; completely different aggregation
difference_from_normalized_SPDT: normalized variant shares the same gain-variance penalty core as SPDT (normalization only scales it); ANLS still unrelated to the penalty form
novelty_risk: MEDIUM for SPDT-family claims (closest comparator; cite + benchmark); NONE for formula duplication

title: Tree stability diagnostics and some remedies for instability (NLS)
methodological_overlap: CONCEPTUAL: bootstrap per node, most frequent split (predictor + median cutoff)

title: Mining High-Speed Data Streams (VFDT)
methodological_overlap: CONCEPTUAL: Hoeffding bound on gain margin before committing split
difference_from_SPDT: uncertainty filter (accept/defer), not a subtractive variance penalty

title: Unbiased Split Selection Based on the Gini Index
authors: Strobl C.; Boulesteix A.-L.; Augustin T.
methodological_overlap: CONCEPTUAL: sampling distribution of maximally selected Gini gain; variance of gain is central
difference_from_SPDT: uses gain variance for hypothesis testing/selection-bias correction, not as a penalty in the score

title: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
methodological_overlap: regularized splitting: loss reduction minus constant gamma (min_split_gain)

title: A Distance-Based Attribute Selection Measure
methodological_overlap: normalizes information gain by a distance measure (gain-ratio family)
difference_from_SPDT: normalizes gain by split descriptor, never penalizes resampling variance

title: Unbiased Recursive Partitioning (Conditional Inference)
authors: Hothorn T.; Hornik K.; Zeileis A.
methodological_overlap: CONCEPTUAL: standardized association statistic (effect / permutation SD)
difference_from_SPDT: significance-filtered splitting; standardized statistic, not gain-minus-variance
difference_from_normalized_SPDT: closest 'normalized statistic' ancestor; still hypothesis-test based
